answer: The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the plume. What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
